question.text: In a 60/40 portfolio, after 1 year of strong equity returns the allocation drifts to 70/30. Rebalancing:

answer.text: Trims equity back to 60% and adds to bonds — reduces risk and locks in gains

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Rebalancing = sell high (equity at new highs), buy low (bonds). Systematic mean-reversion discipline. **The Trap:** Students confuse rebalancing with trend-following. **Cross-Exam Context:** XXI-B Topic 21 deep-dives. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Tax-aware rebalancing: use new inflows to rebalance instead of selling (avoids capital gains tax).
